title: Meibomian Gland Density: An Effective Evaluation Index of Meibomian Gland Dysfunction Based on Deep Learning and Transfer Learning.
summary: Deep-learning segmentation enabled a quantitative meibomian-gland density index, which the authors assessed against clinical meibomian-gland dysfunction status in 85 subjects. The reported AUC was 0.900 for total-eyelid density; the small diagnostic cohort and reuse of earlier training subjects limit independence.
